verdict.rationale: Canny's own install docs tell developers to add a link to the Canny feedback site in their application, and the main site confirms customers can give feedback directly on the Portal. The JavaScript SDK can identify users so their feedback ties to existing accounts, and widget-embed docs exist for web and mobile. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on link configuration (e.g., SSO-authenticated or deep links) beyond the brief instruction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal

citations.quote: In your application, add a link to your Canny feedback site. Put the link somewhere it's easy to find.
or directly from customers on your Portal
